node.title: Re^7: Converting hash into js object properties
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The outputted keys need to be barewords, I believe.

Ah, I see, I misread your post [id://1203910|here] and I thought you were talking about the extra quotes in the values, not the keys. Yes, the quotes around the keys are required by JSON, but JSON is a subset of JavaScript, so if someone is requiring you to omit the quotes, I'd ask why that is and why they can't accept regular JSON.
